output.text: The morning started early at the harbor beach, with the sun barely over the horizon and the sand still cool underfoot. Assume that Finn is the lead volunteer. Everyone gathered near the wooden steps, checking their gloves and trash bags before spreading out along the shoreline. Ana arrived first, carrying a stack of recycling bins she had borrowed from the community center. Vik drove the minibus. Esme showed up a few minutes later, stretching after the short walk from the parking lot, and waved to the others as she set down her water bottle. Lena arrived last, slightly out of breath, having biked the entire way from the north side of town. Ana is in the same class as Esme. The group split into pairs to cover more ground, moving carefully around the tide pools and rocky outcrops. Finn is taller than Vik, though Vik is a faster walker, which made the pairing between them efficient when hauling bags to the collection point. Esme is not in the same class as Lena. Around midmorning, the group paused for a short break, sharing snacks and comparing how many bottle caps and plastic wrappers they had collected so far. Ana is not in the same class as Lena. By early afternoon, the beach looked noticeably cleaner, with neat piles of sorted recyclables lined up near the entrance. Vik mentioned that he was two years older than Esme, while Lena joked that she was still the youngest of the group. As the sun began to dip lower, everyone gathered their things and headed home, tired but satisfied with the work they had done together.
